evidence_summary: Issue #99 is open with zero comments and no assignee.
The requested fix is a bounded contract invariant: reject deposits to inactive subscriptions with Error::SubscriptionInactive and make repeated cancellation non-effectful.
Acceptance requires contract balance stability on failed deposit, no fund movement on a second cancel, cargo test green, and contracts CI green.
payload.recommended_test: Patch deposit_to_subscription and cancel_subscription minimally, then add deterministic Soroban lifecycle tests around cancellation/deposit behavior.
